<badge color="success">My top recommendation</badge> **ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 400W Solar Kit — $731**

Based on the nine pages you provided, this is my pick for the **best overall value if you want a complete kit with substantial solar-panel capacity**.

However, there are two strong alternatives depending on whether you prioritize portability, overall performance, or backup power.

  <row align=start gap={3}>

      <title size="xl" tabularNums={true}>$698.99</title>

    </box>

## Side-by-side comparison

| Kit | Battery | AC output | Panel | Price |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ALLPOWERS P1800 | 1,024 Wh | Not specified in excerpt | 400W | $731 |
| EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic | 1,024 Wh | 1,800W | 220W | $699 |
| Jackery 1000 v2 | 1,070 Wh | 1,500W | 200W | $699 |
| BLUETTI AC180 | 1,152 Wh | Not specified in excerpt | 200W | $769 |
| Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 | Not specified in excerpt | Not specified | 200W | $739.99 |

## Why I'd lean toward ALLPOWERS

The biggest differentiator is the included solar capacity.

A typical 200W panel produces approximately 600–750 Wh over five peak-sun hours, according to Dealectric's estimates.

That means:

- A 200W kit may need substantial sunshine to replenish a depleted 1kWh battery.
- A 400W kit has considerably more potential to recharge the battery during the same sunny day.
- The larger panel capacity is particularly useful if you plan to use the generator regularly rather than simply keep it for emergencies.

The EcoFlow is a compelling alternative if fast AC charging, high inverter output, and UPS functionality matter more than solar-panel capacity.

## My final verdict

| Your priority | My choice |
|---|---|
| Best overall solar value | ALLPOWERS P1800 |
| Best fast charging and output | EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic |
| Best portability | Jackery 1000 v2 |
| Best expandable home backup | Consider saving for a larger system |

**One important caveat:** The supplied excerpts don't establish the ALLPOWERS P1800's inverter output or warranty, so I'd verify those before purchasing. Also confirm the exact panel configuration and compatibility.

For a purchase under $1,000, I'd personally shortlist the **ALLPOWERS P1800 and EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic**, with ALLPOWERS winning on included solar capacity and EcoFlow winning on documented power-station performance.

*All prices are those reported in your supplied pages, not independently verified current checkout prices.*
